title: Select [GLOB]
description:
## GLOB
GLOB is similar to LIKE but with two differences:
1. It's **case-sensitive** (LIKE is not)
2. It uses different wildcards:
   - `*` instead of `%` (any number of characters)
   - `?` instead of `_` (one character)

```sql
-- LIKE: case-insensitive
SELECT * FROM servers WHERE name LIKE 'prod%';  -- matches Prod, PROD, prod

-- GLOB: case-sensitive
SELECT * FROM servers WHERE name GLOB 'prod*';  -- matches prod only
```
